question.text: Which of the given statements is incorrect about glycogen?

options.text: It is present in animal cells.
It is a straight chain polymer similar to amylose.
It is present in some yeast and fungi
Only <math><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><mo>-</mo></math> linkages are present in the molecule.

solution.text: Glycogen is an animal starch. It consists of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><mo>-</mo></math> amylose and amylopectin. Amylopectin is branched chain polysaccharide. Hence statement <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> is incorrect.
